mods.name: sounds-retro
mods.description: 8-bit sounds: a coin when tests pass, a buzz when they fail, a chime when a turn ends.

mods.name: sounds-office
mods.description: Quiet office sounds: a soft click when tests pass, a low thud when they fail, paper when a call is blocked.
